answer_1.quote: We evaluate the multilingual capabilities of LLMs on four representative datasets: • BELEBELE : A widely used language understanding dataset covering 122 languages... • FLORES : A benchmark for machine translation with parallel text from Wikipedia for 204 languages... • XL-SUM : A multilingual abstractive summarization benchmark for 44 languages... • MKQA : An open-domain question-answering dataset across 26 diverse languages...

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the bidirectional translation results between the target language and English, reporting scores using SacreBLEU and COMET score using WMT22-comet-da model. ... ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-L F1 scores are reported. ... we use the official evaluation script and report token overlapped F1 scores.
